text:
alice: forwarded a customer repro — they get a 400 from the tool_call path, error says "invalid JSON in tool args". customer says it used to work last week. paste of the request below.

alice: ```json
{
  "tool": "invoice_pdf",
  "args": "{"invoice_id": 12345, "format": "pdf"}"
}
```

cal: looks like their middleware HTML-encoded quotes inside the stringified `args`. our parser expects `args` to be an object (or a raw JSON string with escaped quotes), not a string containing " entities. do we have the original outbound client library they used?

alice: customer says they're using a custom webhook transform that sanitizes inputs — they probably ran the body through an HTML-escape routine. curl they sent:

alice: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool_call \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tool":"invoice_pdf","args":"{"invoice_id":12345,"format":\"pdf\"}"}'
```

lee: ugly but clear. two possible fixes: (1) fix customer's middleware to not HTML-escape JSON; (2) change their client to send `args` as real JSON object (preferred). quick workaround: send args base64-encoded and decode on server side, but that's messy.

cal: can we add a more helpful 400 message when we detect common html entities in the args string? right now parser just raises generic "invalid JSON" which is not actionable.

alice: created escalation: <https://zendesk.redwood.ai/ticket/INC-2026-345|INC-2026-345> — customer is asking for a fast workaround, can eng triage? :eyes:

support-bot: escalation created INC-2026-345 and assigned to eng-triage.

cal: I'll pick this up. repro steps I used locally: POST same body -> our gateway returns 400, logs show `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError` at the args value because of `"`. I pushed a tiny validation branch that detects `"` or `'` inside args when args is a string and returns 422 with guidance.

cal: sample improved error (proposal):
```
{
  "error": "tool_args_malformed_html_entities",
  "message": "Tool args appear to contain HTML-encoded quotes ("). Ensure args is a JSON object, or unescape HTML entities before sending."
}
```

lee: yeah include link to docs + example of correct payload:
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice_pdf",
  "args": {"invoice_id": 12345, "format": "pdf"}
}
```

alice: customer applied the fix on their middleware (stopped html-escaping the body) and confirmed request now succeeds. they said they'll roll out a patch to stop stringifying the args.

alice: closing this thread but leaving INC-2026-345 open for follow-up on adding a better error and small docs note. :white_check_mark:

cal: thank you — I'll open a PR with the validator + improved message and link it to the ticket.

lee: nice, add a short note in devex docs about common middleware pitfalls (html-escape, double-stringify).

support-bot: INC-2026-345 status updated -> awaiting PR.
